rationale: The robot's performance indicated issues with line tracking stability, evidenced by 3 line loss events and a maximum error of 0.064016. To address this, I reduced the base speed from 0.15 to 0.12 to enhance control, increased the kp value from 0.9 to 1.0 for better responsiveness, and increased the center sensor's weight from 0.6 to 0.8 to improve tracking accuracy. These changes are expected to reduce line loss events and improve overall performance.
